title: driftmatrix: a pre-registered audit of prompt-cache fidelity in llama.cpp under agent traffic
description: Measures whether restoring a llama.cpp prompt cache changes the tool calls an LLM agent makes, across hybrid recurrent, sliding-window and dense models. Includes the pre-registered analysis plan (git tag prereg-2026-09-10), the measurement harness, analysis scripts, tests, and the recorded runs and figures.
